_doc: Global balance constants. Money is in billions (B) of the scenario's reference currency.

naval._doc: Fleets, naval battles, sea control and blockades. See docs/NAVY_AIR.md.

air._doc: Air wings, close air support and strategic bombing. See docs/NAVY_AIR.md.

supply._doc: Logistics: supply levels, attrition, depots. See docs/LOGISTICS.md.

strategic._doc: Nuclear weapons, cyber operations, satellites and space. See docs/STRATEGIC.md.

civilWar._doc: Civil wars: a country below `stability` with at least `disgruntledShare` of its people backing unhappy factions may split each month (chance base × how far below × disgruntled share × 2, at most base). See docs/GOVERNMENT.md.

industry._doc: Industry, labour, market and construction constants. See docs/ECONOMY.md.

government._doc: Factions, legitimacy, elections, coups, revolutions and policies. See docs/GOVERNMENT.md.

diplomacy._doc: Relations, trust, treaties and AI diplomacy. Opinions run -100..100, trust 0..100, reputation -100..100. See docs/DIPLOMACY.md.

research._doc: Research and eras. See docs/TECHNOLOGY.md. Research points a month = rpScale × sqrt(research spending ÷ price level) × education × research multiplier.

commanders._doc: Generals and battle plans (docs/MILITARY.md). skillBonus: damage per skill level. A general rises a level after xpPerSkill × skill experience; xpWin / xpLoss per battle; fallChance: a beaten army's general falls. Hiring costs hireCostRevenueShare of monthly revenue (at least hireCostMin); a country keeps at most one general per army plus `spare`. Attack plans gain up to planMaxBonus attack over planPrepDays of preparation, losing planDecayDay per day once under way. Trait multipliers: attack, defense, speed, orgRecovery, orgLoss (organisation lost in battle), siege; terrain multiplies damage on that terrain; supply is the share of a supply shortage ignored.

espionage._doc: Spy networks (docs/ESPIONAGE.md). A network grows `growth` a month while it is being built (at most maxBuilding at once), less the target's counter-intelligence (counterEffect, plus autocracyCounter for autocracies), and fades `decay` a month otherwise. Each network being built costs networkCostShare of tax revenue a month (at least minCost); counter-intelligence costs as much as counterCostNetworks networks. Operations spend opCost network points; success and detect are base chances. A coup needs stability under coupStability and makes the target a subject when its population is at most puppetPopShare of ours.

council._doc: World council (docs/DIPLOMACY.md, World council): meets from fromYear (League of Nations; United Nations from unYear). A proposal costs proposeInfluence (player) and each country may propose once per proposeCooldownDays; votes close after voteDays. Sanctions last sanctionYears and cost sanctionOpinion with the target for each yes vote; a ceasefire lasts ceasefireDays; a DMZ dmzYears. sanctionGoods lists the goods arms and energy sanctions block. ai: at most one AI proposal per everyDays, with `chance` a month; ceasefires are proposed in wars older than ceasefireAfterDays; arms sanctions on countries with reputation below pariahReputation.

deals._doc: Peacetime deals (docs/DIPLOMACY.md, Deals). Loans: the principal is a multiple (loanAmountMonths) of the borrower's monthly revenue, at most loanMaxMonths outstanding and repayments at most loanMaxServiceShare of its revenue; repaid in equal monthly instalments over loanTermsMonths at one of loanRates a year. A lender keeps lenderReserveMonths of revenue in its treasury and wants lenderBaseRate plus a risk premium. A borrower pays while its debt after paying stays within loanPayDebtMonths of revenue; missedToDefault missed instalments in a row is a default (opinion, trust, reputation, and the lender gets a casus belli for defaultCbYears; repudiating on purpose costs repudiateReputation). Ultimatums cost demandInfluence and demandReputation, ask for up to demandMaxProvinces provinces, demandMoneyMonths of the target's revenue or subjugation, and wait demandDeadlineDays for an answer; a refusal gives a casus belli for demandCbYears, yielding costs the target yieldStability. Personal unions: the junior has at most unionMaxPowerShare of the senior's army and unionMaxProvinces provinces; integration needs unionIntegrateYears in the union, the junior's opinion of the senior at least unionIntegrateOpinion and unionIntegrateInfluence; the junior may break away when its opinion of the senior falls below unionBreakOpinion. Province prices are valued at saleValueYears of the province's tax. Gifts of money raise opinion by giftOpinionPerMonth per month of the recipient's revenue (at most giftOpinionMax). Rebel support costs rebelLevels of the target's monthly revenue a month; per level it lowers the target's stability by rebelStability a month, multiplies its civil-war chance by 1 + rebelChanceBoost, adds a rebel militia unit with rebelMilitiaChance a month in a civil war, and is found out with rebelDetect a month (plus rebelCounterDetect under counter-intelligence).

experience._doc: Army and fleet experience 0..cap: gained per battle (win or loss) plus perDay per day fought (up to maxDays); damage x (1 + exp x bonus). Diluted by recruits, reinforcements, repairs and merges. levels: [minimum, name] for the army card. expertise: the country's military expertise 0..cap (damage x (1 + expertise)), from battles and won wars (warWon + warWonPerYear per year of war, up to 4 years), fading by peaceDecay a month in peace. See docs/MILITARY.md.

capitulation._doc: A country whose own provinces are held by its enemies at the share `occupied` or more, with its capital, capitulates once its war is minDays old (New Game can change the share or turn it off). Terms: a war-score budget of at least minScore, at most maxLandShare of each loser's land by value. See docs/MILITARY.md.

colonisation._doc: Colonist projects on unowned land. cost (B) x province size x price level (x seaCost by sea); days (x seaDays by sea, +5% per sea zone); settlers leave a province with at least sourcePop x settlers people; chance = chance + landBonus (by land) + terrain - hopPenalty per sea zone, 0.2..0.95. At most maxActive + perEra x era at a time. seaReach: [technology, sea zones] the reach of a country's ports. The AI looks every aiEveryMonths months and keeps aiReserveMonths of revenue. See docs/ECONOMY.md.
